name: demo_i4_pipes
source: [AS] assumed generic 2.0 L naturally-aspirated I4 for tools/ps_engine_audio's demo/listening test (ps_audio A10). NOT a real engine - every geometry/table value is a plausible, unmeasured [AS] guess, deliberately mirroring tests/support/cycle_fixtures.h's generic fixture geometry (bore/stroke/valves/lift) and tests/support/cycle_pipe_fixtures.h's generic pipe geometry (intake runners/plenum, exhaust primaries/merge tree), so this file's own map-generation cost/behaviour matches what those tests already exercise. cycle.resolution is set explicitly (audio dx doubled from the ResolutionCycleDesc defaults 0.032/0.017 m to 0.064/0.034 m): at the defaults, a sustained throttle=0.9 hold (data/scripts/engine_audio/free_rev.json, t=3.0-3.8s) seeds a resonant mode with negative numerical damping in the live PipeNetwork that blows up (NaN/railed audio output) by t~4.7s, well after the throttle has already closed again - the coarser dx's extra MUSCL-Hancock/HLLC numerical dissipation removes the blow-up through the whole 8s script including the t=5.5s WOT event. Empirically found by bisection (out/audio_a10_progress.md), not derived from a CFL/damping analysis - a real PipeNetwork numerical-stability edge case at sustained near-WOT load, not specific to this data file's guessed values, flagged for a future ps_audio increment rather than fixed at the solver level here.

cycle.source: [AS] assumed generic cycle-model inputs, not measured - mirrors tests/support/cycle_fixtures.h::make_generic_i4_cycle_desc() (geometry/valves/lift/friction) and tests/support/cycle_pipe_fixtures.h::make_pipe_i4_cycle_desc() (pipe geometry). No real engine's cited data was used.
